projects.name: Responsibilities:
projects.description:
Responsibilities:
Led end-to-end analysis for ACSS, Wires, Cheques, and GL reconciliations as part of HSBC → RBC Payments & Reconciliation Migration, Client Data Migration and Stake holder Management.
Drove end-to-end analysis for HSBC → RBC Payments & Reconciliation Migration, improving reconciliation accuracy by 40% through workflow redesign, GL reconciliation deep-dives, exception analysis, and financial control testing.
Supported digital transformation initiatives across retail banking operations, including payments, customer data migration, and online transaction workflows following the HSBC → RBC acquisition.
Acted as a Business Analyst for retail banking platforms, collaborating with product, technology, and operations teams to improve customer onboarding, account servicing, and digital payment experiences.
Led requirements gathering, BRDs, FRDs, workflow documentation, and data lineage mapping, resulting in enhanced stakeholder alignment and reduced defects.
Built automated Tableau dashboards and SQL pipelines that reduced manual reporting time by
6+ hours weekly and improved KPI visibility.
Analyzed customer transaction journeys across digital channels (retail payments, rewards, account activities) to identify gaps, exceptions, and process inefficiencies.
Directed UAT cycles, authored test scripts, streamlined defect triage, and improved defect closure time by 25% through structured governance.
Ensured compliance with Canadian Payment Systems by integrating operational risk controls and validation frameworks across ACSS, Wires, and payment streams.
Delivered business solutions using SAP FI/GL, ServiceNow, Symphony, and SharePoint, strengthening data accuracy and operational efficiency.

projects.name: Responsibilities:
projects.description:

Led the Reward Points Rollover Project for AMPLI & AVION within RBC, working alongside finance, reconciliation, and technology teams.
Performed detailed reward points reconciliations, resolved payment mismatches, and improved reconciliation accuracy by 35%.
Conducted root-cause analysis on reward discrepancies, operational failures, and system exceptions to support corrective actions.
Utilized SQL, Excel (VBA & pivot models), Power BI / Tableau to build automated reports and deliver insights for leadership.
Designed process improvements and control checkpoints that enhanced customer experience, transaction accuracy, and service turnaround times.
Supported reward programs (AMPLI & AVION) by improving reconciliation logic and customer entitlement accuracy across digital channels.
Redesigned reward-processing workflows, escalation paths, and control checkpoints to enhance operational effectiveness.
Developed SOPs, workflow documents, templates, and knowledge-transfer materials to standardize processes across teams.
